//: Copy this file to 'appsettings.json' (same folder) and edit the values. appsettings.json is gitignored on purpose - never commit your real secrets.
//Postgres: Npgsql connection string. Must point to the same DB you migrated in api/ (see README step 1).
//LocalRegistrationEnabled: Local username/password signup without Discord applications. Missing or false preserves the original approval requirement.
//CdnBaseUrl: Leave empty on a dev server - the site will then serve thumbnails/group icons from disk.
//OwnerUserId: Array of user ids with full staff access. Register an account, then put your own id here and restart.
//Jwt: Private keys, normally provisioned in local-secrets.json by scripts/setup.sh
//ArbiterBaseUrl: URL of game-arbiter, not game-server. The local service listens on :4310.
//Assets: PackageShirtAssetId / PackagePantsAssetId and the signup asset ids refer to assets that must exist in your own DB.
//Directories: Absolute paths, and every one of them MUST end with a trailing slash. The three folders that already ship with the source are pre-filled below - the rest are runtime data folders you have to create yourself.
//AssetValidation: BaseUrl of AssetValidationServiceV2 (it listens on :4300). Used when uploading places/models/animations.
//HCaptcha: Optional Cloudflare Turnstile. Local setups do not need captcha or external keys.
//Render: Optional owned renderer. Leave empty to use pending avatar thumbnails without blocking account creation.
//Discord: Only needed if you want Discord OAuth/login. Can be left empty on a dev server.
